events.title: 3rd Annual Pet a Pony Day
events.why: A small local horsemen's association event ten minutes from Menlo Park where kids learn to brush, tie and feed ponies.

events.title: 52nd Annual Castro Street Fair
events.why: The historic neighborhood street fair founded by Harvey Milk, with artists, vendors, live stages and dance areas; free with a suggested $10-20 donation and an all-ages but adult-leaning crowd.

events.title: Litquake Out Loud + Book Fair
events.why: A free outdoor literary festival with small-press book stalls and poetry readings, good for a reader in the family.

events.title: Little Italy San Jose Italian Festival
events.why: A once-a-year street festival with one of the largest Italian car shows in the country, Italian food and live entertainment.

events.title: Millbrae Japanese Culture Festival
events.why: A close-to-home 21st annual festival with hands-on tea ceremony, calligraphy, origami, games and live stage performances that suit tweens and teens.

events.title: Sparkle and Glow Diwali Festival
events.why: A free school-grounds Diwali celebration with Garba, Bhangra and Bollywood performances, kids' activities, food and a family-friendly evening concert.

events.title: Star Party at Hidden Villa (San Jose Astronomical Association)
events.why: Free telescope viewing of planets and galaxies with astronomy volunteers at a nearby farm; advance registration and a day parking pass are required and it is weather dependent.

events.title: Fleet Week Parade of Ships
events.why: Navy and Coast Guard ships sail under the Golden Gate Bridge behind a fireboat spraying water jets, a free once-a-year spectacle.

events.title: 34th Annual Indigenous Peoples Day Powwow & Indian Market
events.venue: Martin Luther King Jr. Civic Center Park
events.why: A free powwow with competition dancing, drumming, round dances open to everyone and a Native craft and food market; the Grand Entry is at 1 PM.

events.title: 626 Night Market Bay Area
events.why: A big Asian-style night market with 200+ food, craft, game and music stalls that teens tend to love; it runs Oct 9-11 with online-only tickets and $15 parking.

events.title: ArtWalk Livermore + Chalk It Up
events.why: More than 200 artists fill the downtown sidewalks and plazas, with a new concurrent chalk art festival to watch.

events.title: Dublin Harvest Fair
events.why: An old-fashioned fall fair with gold panning, butter churning, a petting zoo and tours of a 1910 farmhouse; entry is free and activity wristbands cost $11 in advance for non-residents.

events.title: Free Boat Rides + Fleet Week Waterfront Fun
events.why: A low-key neighborhood Fleet Week alternative with free boat rides, military challenges, outdoor games and an Air Force brass band.

events.title: Lawton Fall Fest: Student-Built Arcade Games
events.why: A school festival where fifth graders run carnival games they designed and built from recycled materials, in the spirit of Caine's Arcade.

events.title: Mavericks Surf Festival + Big Wave Season Kickoff
events.why: A free coastside festival where the family can meet Mavericks big-wave surfers, watch ocean-safety demos and browse a surf swap with live music and food trucks.

events.title: San Francisco Fleet Week Air Show (Blue Angels)
events.why: The free waterfront air show with the Blue Angels, an F-22, an F-35B and a United 777 flying a choreographed routine; it also runs Oct 9 and Oct 11.

events.title: Tarantula Fest
events.venue: Henry W. Coe State Park headquarters
events.why: A once-a-year park festival with live tarantula encounters, wildlife presentations and guided hikes during the fall tarantula mating season; admission is free but parking is $8 per car.

events.title: Day of the Horse: Family Horse Fair
events.why: Woodside's annual equestrian celebration next door to Menlo Park, with a family horse fair on Sunday themed Year of the Fire Horse (a progressive trail ride for riders is on Saturday Oct 10).

events.title: San Francisco Italian Heritage Parade
events.why: The longest continuously running Italian heritage parade in the US rolls through North Beach with floats, bands and a free Italian auto show, and it coincides with the final Blue Angels show overhead.

events.title: 53rd Safeway World Championship Pumpkin Weigh-Off
events.why: Forklifts hoist one-ton-plus pumpkins onto the scale as growers chase a $30,000 world-record prize, a quirky local tradition that falls on the Indigenous Peoples' Day school holiday.

events.title: Sunrise Gathering on Alcatraz for Indigenous Peoples' Day
events.why: A memorable pre-dawn ferry to a sunrise ceremony commemorating the 1969-71 occupation of Alcatraz, a meaningful school-holiday outing for older kids.
